description: On the green-covered tabletop, there’s a small white square base with two upright white block posts already attached, and another loose white block lying to the right. The left hand stays on the front edge of the base to steady it, while the right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the loose block, moves it leftward over the empty corner slot, then lowers and presses it down until it stands upright like the other posts before releasing.
